tools.name: planka_get_structure
tools.description: Get the full project/board/list structure. Use this to understand what projects and boards exist before working with cards.

projectId.description: Optional: Get structure for a specific project only

tools.name: planka_get_board
tools.description: Get a board with all its lists, cards, and labels. Use this to see everything on a board.

includeTaskCounts.description: Include task completion counts for each card

tools.name: planka_list_cards
tools.description: List the cards of ONE list/column, compact (id, name, labels, task counts, dueDate) and paginated. Prefer this over planka_get_board whenever you only care about one column: on a ~100-card board it returns roughly 1/20th of the text. Descriptions are OFF by default — turn them on only when you actually need them. Returns total/returned/hasMore/nextOffset, so you always know whether you saw everything. Get list IDs from planka_list_lists or planka_get_structure.

withLabels.description: Resolve label names (adds one board fetch). Default true.

withDescription.description: Include a 200-char description preview per card. Default false — this is the expensive one.

labelFilter.description: Only return cards carrying this label name (e.g. 'decidido'; case- and accent-insensitive). Implies withLabels.

limit.description: Max cards to return. Default 25, max 200.

offset.description: Skip this many cards. Use the nextOffset from the previous response to page.

tools.name: planka_list_lists
tools.description: List the columns of a board with how many cards each one holds — no cards, no descriptions. Use it to see the shape of a board and pick which column to open next: it costs a few dozen lines where planka_get_board costs thousands. planka_get_structure gives the same names but NOT the counts.

tools.name: planka_board_summary
tools.description: One-call briefing of a board: every column with its card count, every label, and the cards sitting in the column(s) that are waiting on a decision — flagged by whether they already carry the unblocking label. This is the tool to open a working session with: it answers 'what is on this board and what should I pick up' without dumping the board. By default it picks the decision column by name (matches 'decision'/'decide'/'blocked', accent-insensitive, so '🤔 Necesita tu decisión' works) and highlights the label 'decidido'; override both for other boards. Card payload is minimal (id, name, list, labels) — follow up with planka_get_card for one card, never with planka_get_board.

cardsFrom.description: Which column(s) to return cards from: list IDs, or name fragments matched case- and accent-insensitively (e.g. ['decision'] or ['probalo','miralo']). Default: columns that look like a decision queue.

highlightLabel.description: Label that marks a card as unblocked/ready. Default 'decidido'. Cards carrying it come first and get highlighted:true.

limit.description: Max cards to return. Default 50, max 200.

tools.name: planka_find_cards
tools.description: Search the cards of a board by label and/or text, returning only the matches (id, name, list, labels). Two jobs it does far cheaper than planka_get_board: sweeping every card carrying a label (labelName: 'decidido'), and checking 'does a card about X already exist?' before creating a duplicate. query matches BOTH the card name and its description, case- and accent-insensitive; listId narrows the search to one column. At least one of labelName / query / listId is required. Descriptions are omitted unless withDescription is set, so the answer stays a handful of lines however big the board is.

labelName.description: Only cards carrying this label name (exact name, case- and accent-insensitive). If the board has no such label, the response says so and lists the ones it does have.

query.description: Free text matched against card name AND description (substring, case- and accent-insensitive).

listId.description: Restrict the search to this list (column).

withDescription.description: Include a 200-char description preview per match. Default false.

limit.description: Max matches to return. Default 25, max 200.

offset.description: Skip this many matches. Use nextOffset from the previous response.

tools.name: planka_create_card
tools.description: Create a new card on a board. Optionally add tasks (checklist items) at the same time.

listId.description: The list to create the card in

tasks.description: Optional: Task names to add as a checklist

tools.name: planka_get_card
tools.description: Get full details of a card including tasks, comments, labels, and attachments.

tools.name: planka_update_card
tools.description: Update a card's properties (name, description, due date, completion status).

tools.name: planka_move_card
tools.description: Move a card to a different list or position. Use this for workflow transitions (e.g., 'To Do' -> 'In Progress').

position.description: Position in the list (lower = higher). Default: end of list

tools.name: planka_delete_card
tools.description: Permanently delete a card. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: planka_create_tasks
tools.description: Add one or more tasks (checklist items) to a card.

tools.name: planka_update_task
tools.description: Update a task's name or completion status.

tools.name: planka_delete_task
tools.description: Delete a task from a card.

tools.name: planka_manage_labels
tools.description: Create, update, or delete labels on a board.

color.description: Label color. Valid colors: muddy-grey, autumn-leafs, fresh-salad, lilac-eyes, silver-glint, deep-ocean, summer-sky, grey-stone, sugar-plum, shady-rust, wet-rock, turquoise-sea, lavender-fields, french-coast, sweet-lilac, pirate-gold, berry-red, pumpkin-orange, lagoon-blue, pink-tulip, light-mud, orange-peel, bright-moss, antique-blue, dark-granite, lagune-blue, sunny-grass, morning-sky, light-orange, midnight-blue, tank-green, gun-metal, wet-moss, red-burgundy, light-concrete, apricot-red, desert-sand, navy-blue, egg-yellow, coral-green, light-cocoa, modern-green, piggy-red

tools.name: planka_set_card_labels
tools.description: Add or remove labels from a card. Pass label IDs from the board (planka_get_board lists them), not label names. Reports what actually landed on the card, verified by re-reading it.

addLabelIds.description: Label IDs to add. Alias: `labelIds` (both are accepted and merged).

labelIds.description: Alias of addLabelIds. Label IDs to add.

tools.name: planka_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a card. Use this for status updates, notes, or agent activity logs.

tools.name: planka_get_comments
tools.description: Get all comments on a card.

tools.name: planka_manage_comment
tools.description: Update or delete an existing comment (get IDs from planka_get_comments). Only comments created by the agent user can be modified.

tools.name: planka_manage_lists
tools.description: Create, update, or delete lists on a board.

type.description: List type. Defaults to active when creating.

tools.name: planka_add_attachment
tools.description: Upload a local file (screenshot, log, doc) as an attachment on a card. Verifies the upload by re-reading the card's attachments.

filePath.description: Absolute path of the local file to upload

name.description: Attachment name shown in Planka (defaults to the file's basename). Use descriptive names: antes-…, despues-…, error-consola-…

tools.name: planka_get_attachments
tools.description: List the attachments on a card (id, name, mimeType, size, download URL).

tools.name: planka_view_attachment
tools.description: View an attachment's content. Images are returned so the model can actually see them; text files are returned inline; other types return metadata only.

attachmentId.description: Attachment ID (from planka_get_attachments). If omitted and the card has exactly one attachment, that one is used.

tools.name: planka_delete_attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment from a card.
